reviewNotes: Held back: not provably public domain: Hubert P. Main: public domain needs a death year before 1955, work in print before 1850 ("activeBy"), or "traditional": true for an anonymous source. Imported from CCEH tune 000581 (the melody read from 000581a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's dates (1756–1791) are from our page for the tune MOZART (content/hymns/tunes/mozart.json); CCEH's page gives none. Joshua Leavitt has no death year on CCEH's page or ours; their work is dated 1831, before 1850, so they died before 1955 (they would have been over 105). The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000581a.nwc).
